decision.reasoning_trace: The customer is looking for a mechanical keyboard. The consideration set includes the TECWARE Phantom 87 Key Mechanical Keyboard, E-Yooso 60% Retro Steampunk Mechanical Gaming Keyboard, Akko Keycaps Set, Akko Pink Keycaps Set, and Code V3 104-Key Illuminated Mechanical Keyboard. The final choice, TECWARE Phantom 87 Key Mechanical Keyboard, is selected due to its high rating (4.6), large number of reviews (5974), and competitive pricing ($45.99). It also has a compact tenkeyless design and features Outemu Brown switches, making it a well-rounded option for those seeking a mechanical keyboard.
